headword: {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}

definitions.explanation: Having exceptionally good academic results or performance, often used to describe students who consistently achieve top marks.

examples.japanese: {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}な⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Students with excellent grades were recognized.

examples.japanese: {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{奨学金|しょうがくきん}→奨学金：03230_shougakukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Scholarships are awarded to those with outstanding academic performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}で⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧し、⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She graduated with outstanding grades and got a job at a major company.

notes:
A four-character compound of ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧ (grades, results) + ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧ (excellent, outstanding). Functions as a noun phrase that modifies other nouns with な, as in {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}な⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧. Commonly used in academic and professional contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}な⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧: student with excellent grades
- {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: top achiever
- {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}で⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to graduate with honors
- {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう}{賞|しょう}: academic excellence award

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{優等生|ゆうとうせい}→優等生：26007_yuutousei⟧: honor student — refers to the person, while {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう} describes the performance
- ⟦{秀才|しゅうさい}→秀才：18297_shuusai⟧: prodigy, genius — implies natural talent, while {成績優秀|せいせきゆうしゅう} focuses on actual results
